description: Ideal Dynamics Limited (formerly Ideal Spinning Mills Limited) was incorporated in Pakistan on 8 June 1989 and describes itself as producing high quality yarn and fabric, having grown from spinning into spinning and weaving within the Ideal Group. Its spinning unit runs high speed ring frames with capacity of up to 31,032 spindles, and its principal activity is the manufacture and sale of yarn, cloth and hosiery products. It is a public limited company listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange and sits in the Ideal Group alongside Waqas Spinning Mills (Private) Limited and Ideal Rice Industries (Private) Limited, which are separate companies.
